tasks.partName: Đọc to đoạn văn (Read a Text Aloud)
tasks.prompt: Read the text aloud. You will be evaluated on pronunciation, intonation, and rhythm.

Just call us or go online and tell us your car size and model, give us the address of your destination, and your estimated time of arrival. tasks.partName: Miêu tả bức tranh (Describe a Picture)
tasks.prompt: Describe the picture on your screen in as much detail as possible.

photos.imageDescription: Một thư viện hoặc nhà sách hiện đại với độc giả đang tìm sách và ngồi học tập.
photos.sampleBand8Answer: This is a photograph taken inside a quiet and spacious public library. In the foreground, a student wearing casual clothing is browsing books along tall wooden shelves. In the center, several visitors are seated around a shared study table, diligently reading and taking notes with their laptops open. In the background, high ceilings and large pendant lights illuminate the entire room. Overall, the environment looks serene, studious, and well-organized.

photos.imageDescription: Quầy pha chế quán cà phê nhộn nhịp với barista đang phục vụ đồ uống cho khách hàng.
photos.sampleBand8Answer: This photo captures a lively scene inside a popular modern coffee shop. In the foreground, a barista in an apron is carefully preparing a hot espresso drink behind the counter. On the sleek countertop, there are coffee cups, syrup bottles, and an electronic payment terminal. In the background, customers are waiting in a polite queue while others chat at nearby tables. The warm ambient lighting gives the cafe an inviting and comfortable vibe.

tasks.partName: Trả lời câu hỏi tình huống (Respond to Questions)
tasks.scenario: Imagine that a Canadian market research company is conducting a survey about people’s lifestyle preferences.

questions.question: What’s your favorite kind of museum and why do you like it?
questions.modelAnswer: My favorite kind of museum is a science and technology museum because it features interactive exhibits that allow visitors to engage hands-on with innovative inventions.

questions.question: What’s your favorite place to buy clothing?
questions.modelAnswer: My favorite place to buy clothing is a department store in the downtown shopping district because it provides a wide variety of styles and trusted brands all under one roof.

questions.question: Describe your favorite restaurant
questions.modelAnswer: My favorite restaurant is a cozy Italian bistro near my apartment. They serve authentic homemade pasta dishes with fresh herbs, and the warm, friendly ambiance makes it the perfect place for family gatherings and weekend dinners with close friends.

tasks.partName: Trình bày quan điểm (Express an Opinion)
tasks.prompt: Some people enjoy jobs in which they do the same work every day. Others enjoy jobs that involve changing from project to project. Which type of job would you prefer and why?
tasks.sampleBand8Answer: I personally prefer jobs that involve transitioning from project to project rather than doing repetitive daily tasks. First of all, working on varied projects prevents career stagnation and constantly exposes me to innovative problem-solving. For instance, collaborating with diverse teams on different assignments has allowed me to master new technology frameworks and project management methodologies. Furthermore, handling multifaceted projects keeps daily work intellectually stimulating and rewarding. For these reasons, dynamic project-based work aligns best with my long-term goals.
